Configure package modules

Source: R/sacha-package.R
sacha_configure.Rd

Inspect or update the configuration of the ChecklistBank-backed accessors, iNaturalist image functions, and spatial functions. Each module has its own settings and validation. Pass settings in named lists so that identically named options, such as language, retain a clear module-specific scope. With no arguments, the function visibly returns the active configuration grouped by module. When one or more groups are supplied, only their listed settings are changed and the resulting configuration is returned invisibly.

sacha_configure(global = NULL, inat = NULL, spatial = NULL)

Arguments

global

Optional named list of settings for the ChecklistBank and taxonomic-indexation module.

inat

Optional named list of settings for iNaturalist image queries, downloads, and cache safeguards.

spatial

Optional named list of settings for GBIF maps and spatial accessors.

Value

The nested active configuration. It is returned visibly for a query and invisibly after an update.

Details

The global group configures ChecklistBank accessors and taxonomic indexation links. Its available fields are dataset, base_url, gbif_base, inat_base, source_name, taxon_url_template, language, fetcher, and labels. dataset defaults to "3LXR"; URL fields must use HTTP or HTTPS. language accepts an installed language file or one of its declared aliases. taxon_url_template may be NULL to omit taxon links, and fetcher may be NULL to restore the built-in ChecklistBank adapter. labels is a named list of language-specific label overrides. This configuration is shared by sc_full_name() and the Catalogue of Life lookups in locations().

The inat group configures iNaturalist requests and image handling. It accepts inat_api, checklistbank_api, catalogue_dataset, user_agent, language, default_quality_grade, default_images_directory, default_image_size, default_save_image_size, cache_max_entries, request_delay, small_download_delay, large_download_delay, hourly_media_limit_gb, and daily_media_limit_gb. default_quality_grade accepts "research", "needs_id", or "casual"; image sizes accept "small", "square", "medium", "large", or "original". Both default_image_size and default_save_image_size default to "medium". The cache capacity must be a positive whole number or Inf. Search and larger-media delays must be at least 1 second; smaller-media delays must be at least 0.5 seconds. Media ceilings must be positive and no greater than 5 GB per hour or 24 GB per day. Defaults are 1.02 seconds, 0.55 seconds, 4.5 GiB per hour, and 21.5 GiB per day. The language must identify an installed language file, endpoint URLs must use HTTP or HTTPS, and user_agent must be non-empty.

The spatial group accepts language, default_limit, http_timeout, http_max_tries, and cache_ttl. The defaults are English, 2,000 records, a 30-second HTTP timeout, three attempts, and an unlimited cache age. default_limit must be between 1 and 100,000; http_timeout and cache_ttl must be positive, with Inf accepted for cache_ttl; and http_max_tries must be at least one.

Settings in different groups remain independent even when they have similar names. For example, language in global, inat, and spatial changes only that module's default. The global ChecklistBank dataset and API are shared by sacha_clb.R and locations.R; the iNaturalist attribution dataset remains independently configurable.

References

ChecklistBank API: https://api.checklistbank.org/. GBIF API documentation: https://techdocs.gbif.org/en/openapi/. iNaturalist API v2: https://api.inaturalist.org/v2/docs/. iNaturalist API recommended practices: https://www.inaturalist.org/pages/api+recommended+practices.

See also

sacha_clear_cache(), sacha_arg_configure()

Examples

# \donttest{
sacha_configure()
#> $global
#> $global$taxon_url_template
#> [1] "https://www.catalogueoflife.org/data/taxon/%s"
#> 
#> $global$base_url
#> [1] "https://api.checklistbank.org"
#> 
#> $global$inat_base
#> [1] "https://api.inaturalist.org/v2"
#> 
#> $global$gbif_base
#> [1] "https://api.gbif.org/v1"
#> 
#> $global$source_name
#> [1] "Catalogue of Life"
#> 
#> $global$fetcher
#> NULL
#> 
#> $global$label_overrides
#> list()
#> 
#> $global$language
#> [1] "en"
#> 
#> $global$dataset
#> [1] "3LXR"
#> 
#> 
#> $inat
#> $inat$catalogue_dataset
#> [1] "3LXR"
#> 
#> $inat$request_delay
#> [1] 1.02
#> 
#> $inat$large_download_delay
#> [1] 1.02
#> 
#> $inat$default_images_directory
#> [1] "."
#> 
#> $inat$cache_max_entries
#> [1] 200
#> 
#> $inat$user_agent
#> [1] "sacha-r-package/1.0 (iNaturalist image client)"
#> 
#> $inat$default_quality_grade
#> [1] "research"
#> 
#> $inat$daily_media_limit_gb
#> [1] 21.5
#> 
#> $inat$hourly_media_limit_gb
#> [1] 4.5
#> 
#> $inat$default_save_image_size
#> [1] "medium"
#> 
#> $inat$checklistbank_api
#> [1] "https://api.checklistbank.org"
#> 
#> $inat$language
#> [1] "en"
#> 
#> $inat$default_image_size
#> [1] "medium"
#> 
#> $inat$small_download_delay
#> [1] 0.55
#> 
#> $inat$inat_api
#> [1] "https://api.inaturalist.org/v2"
#> 
#> 
#> $spatial
#> $spatial$cache_ttl
#> [1] Inf
#> 
#> $spatial$http_max_tries
#> [1] 3
#> 
#> $spatial$gbif_checklist_key
#> [1] "7ddf754f-d193-4cc9-b351-99906754a03b"
#> 
#> $spatial$default_limit
#> [1] 2000
#> 
#> $spatial$language
#> [1] "en"
#> 
#> $spatial$http_timeout
#> [1] 30
#> 
#> 
sacha_configure(
  global = list(language = "es", dataset = "COL25"),
  inat = list(language = "en", default_image_size = "large"),
  spatial = list(default_limit = 500)
)
# }
